Location: The location of the property is one of the most important factors in determining its value.

Size and layout: The size and layout of the property are important factors in determining its value.

Condition: The condition of the property is also an important factor in determining its value.

Comparable sales: The appraiser will look at recent sales of similar properties in the area to determine the value of the property.
